source_category_coverage.result: Directly inspected the Tailor stub/MTs/spec anchors and the validated-but-merge-withheld PoseKit packet, schemas, tests, and implementation.

Inspected wgpu, IPC, a GPU XPBD implementation, AccessKit, MaterialX, Genesis release notes, and an NVIDIA Warp topology-update issue; reused patterns only where the project boundary and proof plan support them.
Inspected Marvelous Designer, CLO, Daz, Blender, Houdini, OpenUSD, MaterialX, OCIO/color, WCAG, and AccessKit documentation for professional workflows and UI contracts.
Inspected XPBD, IPC/C-IPC, GarmentCodeData, RGBench, and NVIDIA SOMA-X evidence for solvers, corpora, body-model separation, validation, and limitations.
Inspected GarmageSet, GarmentCodeData, RGBench, and SOMA-X; corpus licenses, access gates, and research-only assets are not treated as shippable BodyKit content.

Inspected current and historical Marvelous Designer/CLO reports for crashes, missing autosaves, large-pattern lag, lost selection, workspace recovery, and cross-window manipulation; used them as failure scenarios, not technical authority.
Searched for relevant professional 3D cloth, BodyKit creator-tool, and anatomy implementation evidence; no source suitable for architectural authority was adopted.

Used RGBench and contact oracle fixtures for benchmark structure, plus field crash/data-loss reports and source issue/release evidence for recovery and qualification gates; no feature-name-only parity claim was accepted.

selected_approach: One versioned Tailor world with GPU f32 interactive XPBD, CPU f64 XPBD reference, and pure-Rust CPU f64 contact-safe nonlinear final solve.
One native shell and one typed command registry across operator, model, Argus, MCP, history, replay, receipts, and manual.
One shared scene/selection/property/history/jobs/problems/validation world for Cloth and BodyKit.
Versioned original BodyKit source assets plus native creator/repair tools; validators do not substitute for content.
PoseKit remains typed hashed 2D evidence; Tailor owns explicit lift, camera, joint-map, contact, proposal, and promotion contracts.
MaterialX/OpenPBR/OCIO plus composed OpenUSD publishing and version-pinned downstream qualification.
rejected_options: Start product coding from the current signed spec/653 chain.
Maintain parallel React/Tauri and native Tailor frontends.
Treat EventLedger or panel snapshots as full undo/autosave/recovery.
Treat PoseKit's 2D pixels, lens_mm, or misleading 3D viewport author_id as 3D authority.
Use hard zero-region deformation masks as the definition of channel independence.
Claim Daz or professional-DCC parity from feature names, cargo tests, or raw USD/glTF export alone.
Silently truncate contacts, mutate parameters, skip required release qualification, or fall back without typed receipts.
